candidate.titleZh: 共享延迟启动冷却任务的状态描述
candidate.evidenceScope: source-only; no fresh runtime observations or validation were performed
candidate.sourceFinding: In both frozen PRE122 roots, Character.SetCDWithDelay schedules a bare Tasks.Add closure whenever delay != 0; that pending closure has no phase descriptor. The later startCooldownQueueWorker already uses AddWithPhase. The initial movement-only patch did not touch cooldown.go; the delayed-start descriptor was then integrated in the same batch. This gap is now integrated in batch122; it is no longer the next pending code change.

gapProvider.gap: queued task "" has an undescribed closure

candidate.whyBroad: One shared scheduling site is called throughout character skill and burst implementations; no per-character callback migration is required.

countDefinition: Counts are static .SetCDWithDelay( call sites in non-test .go files under internal/characters, not helper definitions, runtime invocations, supported characters or completed mechanics. Calls with computed or zero delay are included. Top-level directories group traveler variants together.

proposal.change: Replace only the nonzero-delay Tasks.Add with Tasks.AddWithPhase, using the exact original callback and delay expression. The file already imports phase.

capture.characterIndex: c.Index(), a pure semantic reference to the captured character
capture.originalDurationFrames: dur, original captured input before future cooldown modifiers

existingSchedulerState: origin and task lifecycle are retained through task.add
preserve: The delay == 0 synchronous branch and original handling of any other delay remain unchanged.
Do not call SetCD, CDReduction, Cooldown, modifier.Amount or any stat read while observing.
Evaluate current cooldown modifiers only when the original task actually executes.
Keep later cooldown worker creation, source-pointer cancellation checks and both lane gameplay differences unchanged.

dependencies.readsAndWrites: Calls live CDReduction, appends resulting duration, may start a worker, decrements AvailableCDCharge and logs. No additional closure-local values beyond c/a/dur are read.
Reads ordered live CooldownMod entries, expiry versus character clock and Amount(action); removes expired modifiers. Calling this in Observe would mutate state and could execute arbitrary callbacks.

dependencies.coverage: Already copies action cooldowns, charge counts, duration queues, worker presence, relative worker time and remaining cooldown.
Already includes CooldownMod metadata and delegates Amount closure capture to SourceHostPhaseCallback; unreviewed modifier callbacks remain explicit gaps.
Returns a missing source-reviewed live capture descriptor gap when Amount metadata is absent.
Both APIs use the same queue clock, FIFO counter, origin capture and task tracker.

laneConstraint: SetCDWithDelay and its capture contract are identical in these lanes. Other cooldown functions differ (Stellar DiscardActionCooldown and queue/charge behavior); do not normalize or copy the whole file between lanes.
boundedOutcome: Describes this pending task family; it does not certify arbitrary cooldown modifier callbacks, whole characters, full phase closure, gameplay timing accuracy or source/game agreement. No existing runtime gap-count decrease is claimed.

notSelected.reason: Inspected registrations are character-specific closures rather than one shared producer; would require a different bounded audit.
Its stored key, element, tags, expiry and override policy already have a shared source observer; no new callback gap was found in this handler.

validation.implementationScope: Private copies only; source roots unchanged; parent integration pending.
